For a ₹10 lakh/month Mumbai D2C store:

Gateway	Transaction fee*	Settlement	Checkout	Onboarding
Razorpay	~2% + GST	T+1; instant settlement available	Excellent D2C checkout, UPI, cards, 100+ methods	Fast, strong integrations
Cashfree Payments	~1.95% + GST**	T+1; instant settlement option	Strong UPI/card checkout, good APIs	Quick, KYC-based
PayU	~2% + GST**	T+1/T+2; priority settlement available	150+ payment modes, strong success-rate focus	Established, more enterprise-oriented

Razorpay offers D2C-focused Magic Checkout and instant settlements. 
razorpay.com
 PayU supports 150+ modes, priority settlements and D2C checkout/RTO tools. 
payu.in

My pick: Cashfree for cost, Razorpay for overall D2C experience. Actual rates are negotiable; confirm your merchant quote before switching.
